read_cameras_text: read camera parameters from a COLMAP text file and return a dictionary of Camera namedtuples
read_cameras_binary: read camera parameters from a COLMAP binary file and return a dictionary of Camera namedtuples
read_images_text: read image poses and 2D keypoints from a COLMAP text file and return a dictionary of Image namedtuples
read_images_binary: read image poses and 2D keypoints from a COLMAP binary file and return a dictionary of Image namedtuples
read_model: read the complete COLMAP reconstruction model including cameras, images, and 3D points from a given path and format
